registry_note: The column order of the 138-vector is a literal in src/feature_extraction/registry.py and is fingerprinted; two runs that disagree on that fingerprint are not comparable. This list is in that order and is never sorted by name.

features.name: time_mean
features.description: Mean amplitude of the preprocessed signal

features.name: time_kurtosis
features.description: Tailedness of the amplitude distribution; excess kurtosis

features.name: time_peak_to_peak
features.description: Peak-to-peak excursion; equals range, kept because the blueprint lists both

features.name: time_crest_factor
features.description: Peak-to-RMS ratio; high for impulsive sounds

features.name: time_zcr_std
features.description: Variability of the framed zero-crossing rate

features.name: time_shannon_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of the amplitude distribution

features.name: time_sample_entropy
features.description: Sample entropy; regularity of the waveform

features.name: time_autocorr_peak_value
features.description: Strength of the dominant periodicity; a rhythm-regularity proxy

features.name: time_autocorr_peak_lag
features.description: Period of the dominant periodicity; a cardiac-cycle proxy

features.name: freq_bandwidth_mean
features.description: Mean spectral spread about the centroid

features.name: freq_flatness_mean
features.description: Mean Wiener entropy; 1 is noise-like, 0 is tonal

features.name: freq_flux_mean
features.description: Mean spectral change between consecutive frames

features.name: freq_spectral_entropy
features.description: Normalized spectral entropy of the Welch PSD, in [0, 1]

features.name: freq_peak_power
features.description: Power spectral density at the dominant frequency

features.name: freq_total_power

selected.stability_note: Feature selection runs inside the training fold, so a feature is selected in some number of folds rather than globally. A feature kept in 3 of 25 folds and one kept in 25 are both listed here and are not the same claim, which is why the count is on every row.

example_vector.note: One recording's full 138-vector, in the locked registry order. This is the same record the inference gate scores, so its waveform, its features and its stored out-of-fold probability are all the same bytes.
